source.h_model_method: rest pose, the body mesh (char1) skinned at rest by the runtime importer: crown (max up) minus sole (min up), metres (every 7th vertex; sole 0.0001, crown 1.6996)

camera.frame: port model: x screen-right, y toward camera, z up; origin = character ground origin
camera.character_heading: theta = 90 - bearing about +Y (her model faces +Z); frame-0 root forward measured per cell

image.lights_detail: the Barrow's winter sun (paint_stack.gd: 55 deg, screen azimuth 305, (1.0, 0.955, 0.885), energy 0.90, shadow blur 1.7) as a child of the camera, ambient 0.30 white; self-shadowing only (no ground)

idle.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

walk.stride_method: the clip is in place at source; stride = the manifest's FOOT-LOCK speed (1.449 m/s, the speed that holds the planted foot still) x the clip length (1.0000 s)
walk.closure_mad_note: max over the 8 directions of mean |RGBA(T) - RGBA(0)| over the FIGURE's pixels (either frame opaque), 0-255; render(T) is rendered for this and is not in the pack

sockets_def.cast_hand: the casting hand's PALM (wrist + 0.07 m along the hand): the LEFT hand (the Fire Ball hand, her free hand) in every state but cast_meteor, where the RIGHT hand calls it
sockets_def.head_top: the top of the head: the head_end joint
sockets_def.main_grip: the staff grip: the weapon_r joint (the fist's channel centre)
sockets_def.main_tip: the staff's crown end: weapon_r + 0.8765 m along its +Y (the staff spans -0.8713 .. +0.8765 m there; the Meteor's baked slide moves weapon_r and the tip with it)
